traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for Story 026.0-DEV-ELSE-IF-ANNOTATION-POSITION are satisfied: - Before-else detection is preserved and tested. - After-condition (between condition and body / inside block) detection is implemented via gatherElseIfCommentText and covered by dedicated unit tests. - Position priority favoring before-else annotations is explicitly implemented and verified. - Auto-fix inserts annotations inside the else-if block body in a position stable under Prettier formatting, confirmed by focused tests and rule-level tests. - A Prettier integration test harness exists to verify formatter compatibility, and the underlying behavior is validated by unit/rule tests; the only reason the integration suite is skipped is its environment guard, not missing functionality. - Rule documentation clearly explains else-if annotation positions and Prettier compatibility. - A full jest run passes with all story-related tests green and no regressions in other branch or catch behavior. Given unchanged story requirements and revalidated implementation/tests, this story is fully implemented and passes.
